title: An absorbed fix in a routing overlay is undeliverable by every dispatched role
body:
twa's whole fix is four kind cells of .tick/runners.cloud.toml, but the worker boundary exempts only .tick/config.md, .tick/runners.toml and .tick/learnings.md (internal/exec/subprocess/report.go:190), so every dispatched attempt of twa hits the same wall — the hn6 yjq shape, config edition. The yjq remedy (the tracker-edit proposal path) covers tracker records only, so there is no path by which the run's own machinery can land an overlay-cell fix: attempts burn the ladder answering BLOCKED while kkt and the final review wait on the flip. Either grow the boundary exemption to the routing overlays (an operator design call — the overlays are the model/price surface), or give findings an overlay-proposal path the run applies as it applies tracker edits, or leave overlay fixes to the operator on the PR — but then absorption should not create a dispatched tick for them.
evidence: internal/exec/subprocess/report.go:190-194 (exemptFromBoundary, no overlay); internal/reconcile/tracker_edits.go:18-21 (the yjq wall, tracker records only); .tick/issues/twa.json (the tick); .tick/issues/kkt.json (names twa's flip as A4's dependency); image/common.sh:215-216 (what the overlay's 'pi' does at boot)
